package_lineage.signing: repacked and signed with the development certificate; unpacked payloads of the CI and signed packages are identical
package_lineage.worker_source_note: PR #249 merge commit embedded as FLYMSG_COMMIT

protocol.activity: looming escape drives DNp01 and TTMn (battery positive); bitter feeding is the battery negative that stays silent at MN9
protocol.model: MaleCNS v1.0 default model, version-1 fixture (no graded or coupled neurons)
protocol.revision_3: cross-vendor review fixes, no change to cases or measures: a failed result or output read-back is recorded as `readback_failed`; the console copy is deleted only when the downloaded bytes match the worker's reported hash; a zero first window gives no last/first ratio instead of an exception
protocol.revision_4: 2026-10-18, before measuring it: adds `long-looming-sparse`, one 1,500,000-step looming job in the sparse kick encoding (fixture v3), beyond the ~760k-step cap that dense kicks hit within the 512 MiB GPU input budget; existing cases unchanged and not rerun
protocol.revision_reason: attempt 1 (1d1fde5) kept each job's fixture, checkpoint and output on the console; the third 500k-step upload got HTTP 500 and the script stopped without a record. Revision 2 deletes a job's large files from the console once its output is downloaded and hashed, and records a Device Portal error as the job's final state
protocol.v2_full_connectome: not measured: no full-connectome version-2 configuration is exportable (per-neuron membranes are refused by flymsg.native), so only the synthetic graded lifecycle (scripts/console_lifecycle.py --extension graded) covers v2
protocol.verdicts: per case: pass when every job completes with the oracle's output; fail on any other final state or output; throttling is reported, not judged
